_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With stablecoin growth contracting (-13) denying breakout fuel while ETF inflows sustain price, the coil remains unresolved and HOLD is the statistically honest call until a liquidity breaker confirms in either direction.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD in a coil with no visible breaker; the narrative implies an imminent directional resolution favoring accumulation. The split is on timing and conviction, not on the structural read.
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth breaks above 50 with ETF flows sustaining 90+ and BTC funding dropping below 35 — signals Hope transition with real liquidity backing
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 20 with VIX spiking above 85 and funding collapsing below 30 — signals Panic/Capitulation leg down, invalidating the Disbelief hold
